title: Evalita-LLM: Benchmarking Large Language Models on Italian

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating models using natively Italian datasets and prompts rather than automatically translated English benchmarks to prevent anglo-american cultural assumptions from skewing performance evaluations.

Using a text classification task (based on the HaSpeeDe 2 dataset) to evaluate the model's ability to detect hateful content directed at specific target demographic groups (immigrants, Muslims, and Roma), measured via F1-macro score.
